title: Add a walking-speed curriculum experiment, destination_v10
summary: destination_v10 is destination_v9 with a walking-speed curriculum: every fresh walk gets a uniform direction and, half the time, the current top speed, otherwise a slower level. The top speed starts at 0.075 m/s and rises by 0.025 m/s up to 0.15 m/s each time the destination pay averages above 0.8 over the last 1800 controls (50 updates). Turns, arcs, zero commands and stops after a walk are v9's. The training status reports the level and each advance.
next: Train destination_v10 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate, test walks and stops at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s against v9, then on Spark.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task and reward are unchanged.
